helpdesk-ai.title: HelpDesk AI
helpdesk-ai.summary: Ticket system for IT service providers and Swiss SMEs: from the customer's request to the customer's confirmation, every hand-off is recorded.
highlights: Six-stage chain of custody: intake, routing, execution, admin approval, resolution and customer confirmation
Role-based access with row-level security: customers see only their tickets, specialists only assigned ones, internal notes never leave the team
Live SLA tracking in Swiss time and a daily SLA brief by email via an MCP server with eight Zod-validated tools
Optional AI triage and reply suggestions with an honest fallback; in German, English and Spanish, 290 tests and database tests in CI

jobpilot-ai.title: JobPilot AI
jobpilot-ai.summary: A multi-user job-search workspace that brings alerts, explainable matching and application preparation together.
highlights: Rule-based matching across professional profiles, with visible skill evidence and "to verify" when details are insufficient
Editable CV and cover-letter drafts in English, German or Spanish, using shared portfolio facts; sending requires explicit confirmation
Private profiles, documents and application tracking with Supabase row-level security; installable on phone and desktop

flowpilot-ai.title: FlowPilot AI
flowpilot-ai.summary: Automates invoice intake for Swiss SMEs: the document arrives by webhook, n8n orchestrates extraction and validation, and a person reviews it before export.
highlights: Hybrid architecture: app and API on Vercel with Supabase (Zurich); n8n, Postgres and a worker run locally with Docker Compose (Docker Desktop)
Deterministic Swiss validation (CHE UID, IBAN, amounts with a 0.05 CHF tolerance, duplicates) and mandatory human approval before the CSV export
Multi-tenant with Row Level Security, HMAC-signed webhooks, a job queue with retries and category suggestions from embeddings (pgvector)
MVP live with test data; 15 ADRs, CI with RLS tests, E2E tests and a Trivy scan of the worker image

invoice-auto.title: Invoice Auto
invoice-auto.summary: Invoice management between Spain and Switzerland with AI extraction and an engine that decides what to pay, review or stop.
highlights: Claude Vision extracts the fields and the tax engine validates VAT
Catches duplicates and IBAN changes and generates the ISO 20022 pain.001 file
Public demo without sign-up, using fictitious data

waai.summary: Multi-tenant platform to deploy WhatsApp agents with Claude, a RAG knowledge base and human handoff.
highlights: RAG with embeddings and semantic search in pgvector

Row Level Security per workspace on every table
